scenes.title: Phosphor, diffusion, and cooling make a useful bulb

vo.text: This LED bulb produces bright light while using much less power than an old incandescent bulb.
vo.speak: This LED bulb produces bright light while using much less power than an old incandescent bulb.

vo.text: Its light comes from tiny semiconductor chips, not from a glowing metal filament.
vo.speak: Its light comes from tiny semiconductor chips, not from a glowing metal filament.

vo.text: The bulb's driver changes household electricity into a controlled direct current.
vo.speak: The bulb's driver changes household electricity into a controlled direct current.

vo.text: Inside each LED, electrons and holes move toward a junction in the semiconductor.
vo.speak: Inside each LED, electrons and holes move toward a junction in the semiconductor.

vo.text: When they recombine, they release energy as photons, which are particles of light.
vo.speak: When they recombine, they release energy as photons, which are particles of light.

vo.text: The chip's materials set the light's color, and a phosphor coating can create white light.
vo.speak: The chip's materials set the light's color, and a phosphor coating can create white light.

vo.text: A diffuser spreads that light evenly, while the metal body carries heat away.
vo.speak: A diffuser spreads that light evenly, while the metal body carries heat away.

vo.text: So controlled current powers semiconductor junctions that turn electrical energy directly into light.
vo.speak: So controlled current powers semiconductor junctions that turn electrical energy directly into light.
